messages.en:
{07 0a 00}I got rid of my cold,{01 00 00 05 00}
and now I feel SUPER,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 14 00}It's all because of your
{ff 00 00 07}medicine{ff 00 00 00}, {04 1f 00}! You
are so crazy nice!
So here's a little something
for being such a nice
person, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 0a 00}Ma sain külmetusest lahti,{01 00 00 05 00}
ja nüüd tunnen end
SUPERINA, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 14 00}See kõik on tänu sinu
{ff 00 00 07}rohule{ff 00 00 00}, {04 1f 00}! Sa
oled nii hullult kena!
Nii et siin on väike miski
selle eest, et sa oled
nii kena, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, I can't BELIEVE
you came to see me so
many times!
{07 14 00}Thanks to you, I'm fully
recovered, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 04 00}Oh, yeah!{01 00 00 05 00} Here!{01 01 00} {07 14 00}I want you
to take this as my
appreciation token!!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, ma ei USU,
et sa tulid mind vaatama
nii mitu korda!
{07 14 00}Tänu sinule olen ma
täiesti terve, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 04 00}Ah jaa!{01 00 00 05 00} Siin!{01 01 00} {07 14 00}Ma tahan, et
sa võtaksid selle minu
tänutäheks!!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Oh, {04 1f 00}! Thanks to
your {ff 00 00 07}medicine{ff 00 00 00},{01 00 00 05 00} I feel, like,
totally AMAZING now!
{07 0c 00}WAIT!{01 01 00} {07 0d 00}I've gotta thank the
special person who saved
me, {04 1f 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Oh, {04 1f 00}! Tänu
sinu {ff 00 00 07}rohule{ff 00 00 00},{01 00 00 05 00} tunnen ma end,
nagu, täiesti VAPUSTAVALT!
{07 0c 00}OOTA!{01 01 00} {07 0d 00}Ma pean tänama
erilist inimest, kes mu
